verdict.rationale: The only webhook references describe Supermemory's own connectors (Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, etc.) using webhooks internally to auto-sync data into Supermemory — this is inbound sync, not a documented mechanism for an AI-native user to subscribe to Supermemory's own events (e.g., memory-created, profile-updated) via outbound webhooks. No docs, API reference, or probes mention an event subscription/webhook endpoint for consumers of the platform.
